note: Provenance for the reference blueprint library. The binaries themselves live in ./sources/ and are deliberately not committed - they are other people's creative work, and this repository is public. Only the measured facts derived from them are committed, as the generated module companion/lib/blueprint-reference-catalog.mjs. Run scripts/ingest-blueprint-reference.mjs to rebuild that module from a local ./sources/ folder.

entries.notes: Pure architecture: dresses an existing miner with no production machine of its own. The clearest example in the library of enclosure-and-detail work as a standalone, reusable unit.
